# @loom/plugin-mcp-app

MCP Apps (SEP-1865, `io.modelcontextprotocol/ui`) egress — projects a Loom agent surface onto the extension as ONE static, content-pinned surface-host template whose payload is the existing A2UI catalog model, plus an app-visibility surface cursor tool that closes the extension's missing server-push channel. Egress only: the host role (iframe, CSP, postMessage) is deliberately out of scope.

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-mcp-app`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
